tasks.short: Review footage, recordings and rehearsals against production and broadcast standards.

steps.what: Locate the current production version and applicable standards using native media markers
outputs: checked review sources and production version

steps.what: Review the film, recordings or rehearsal and judge conformance to the applicable standards
inputs: checked review sources and production version

steps.what: Write and approve exact findings, timecodes, standards references and required corrections
inputs: checked review sources and production version

steps.what: Save the approved final conformance review notes

tasks.design: Configure the {MEDIA_REVIEW} native version and marker view; OTHER denotes that tool. Retrieve the correct footage and standards with less navigation. Retain complete viewing, rehearsal observation and conformance judgement. Findings are written and approved before a separate same-system save with no save benefit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Version and requirement retrieval may interrupt review.
tasks.enabler_now: Native media version and marker navigation can reduce source-finding effort.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding whether content meets technical, editorial and broadcast requirements.
tasks.human_edge: The director interprets content and context rather than treating a technical pass as complete conformity.
tasks.altitude: Human conformance review with native source navigation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native media review tools can navigate existing versions and timecode markers.

assumptions: Shares are provisional; confirm residual navigation after existing media features. Existing playback, rendering and checks earn no new saving.

Editor supplies existing asset_id, version and timecode metadata; production owner supplies actual current requirements. s1 retains currency checks; missing metadata uses manual retrieval. s3 captures actual finding, timecode, requirement and correction at full time.
No model approves conformance or sends findings. The separated save remains fully retained.
research_questions: Does the current media tool already bring the right version and applicable requirements together?

incremental.description: Maintain requirement links and current-version view

approvals.approved_version: s3 final conformance findings and production version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only retrieval changes: 15 times 30% = 4.5 less 1 upkeep = 3.5. Low halves retrieval benefit: 2.25 minus 1 = 1.25.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study and research scripts to decide how to direct them.

steps.what: Find current script scenes and previously collected research using native document navigation
inputs: existing director research notes and references
outputs: checked script and research source set

steps.what: Study and research the script and develop the intended direction
inputs: checked script and research source set
outputs: director-developed script interpretation and research findings

steps.what: Write and approve directing notes with precise scene references and research sources
inputs: director-developed script interpretation and research findings

steps.what: Save the approved final directing research notes

tasks.design: Configure native scene headings, bookmarks and source links in {DOCS}. Reduce retrieval of existing script and research records while retaining reading, new research, interpretation and writing. Approval and same-system save remain separate; save earns no benefit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current scene and existing research may require repeated document searches.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document navigation can connect existing scenes and source notes.
tasks.still_hard: Researching unfamiliar material and developing a coherent directorial interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The director decides how the script should feel and be performed.
tasks.altitude: Human script research with easier retrieval.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document headings, bookmarks and source links reduce repeated retrieval of existing material.

assumptions: Provisional shares assume residual retrieval after native document features; no creative research or reading is treated as machine runtime.

Writer supplies existing versioned script and scene identifiers. Director supplies existing research notes and captures all new findings and source references in s2-s3 at full time. Missing or conflicting sources require manual research.
s1 checks script version and source context. The save is unchanged and fully retained.
research_questions: Which existing scenes or research sources are repeatedly located manually?

incremental.description: Maintain scene bookmarks and research links

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final directing research notes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only existing-source retrieval changes: 10 times 40% = 4 hours less 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Low halves retrieval benefit: 2 minus 0.5 = 1.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise and coordinate camera, lighting, design and sound crews.

steps.what: Check current crew tasks and production dependencies in the native production view
inputs: existing crew task status and dependencies

steps.what: Supervise actual crew work and resolve camera, lighting, design and sound dependencies
inputs: actual crew work and technical constraints

steps.what: Write and approve final crew instructions, task owners and sequencing changes
outputs: approved final crew instructions and recipients

steps.what: Deliver the approved final coordination instructions to the relevant crew members
inputs: approved final crew instructions and recipients
steps.handoff_to: camera, lighting, design and sound crews

steps.what: Capture and approve actual crew responses and resulting coordination status
outputs: approved final actual crew coordination record

steps.what: Save the approved final crew coordination record
inputs: approved final actual crew coordination record

tasks.design: Configure the existing {PRODUCTION_SYSTEM} native task and schedule view, represented by OTHER and PROJECT. The director checks sources, supervises and decides. Final instructions are approved before separate delivery; actual responses are captured afterwards. Same-system status save earns no benefit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current crew tasks and dependencies may be scattered across native views.
tasks.enabler_now: Production systems can present existing schedules and crew tasks together.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving creative and technical conflicts while crews work.
tasks.human_edge: The director makes contextual tradeoffs and maintains shared understanding.
tasks.altitude: Human crew supervision with current production information.

evidence.claim: Production tools provide schedules and call sheets; a native combined view is a proposed configuration, not a measured local saving.

assumptions: Shares are provisional; existing combined views or schedule generation earn no additional saving.

Production coordinator and crew leads supply existing task_id, owner, planned_time, dependency and reported_status in normal production work. No new upstream status capture is assumed. s1 checks freshness; missing data requires manual coordination.

s3 captures/checks actual final instructions before delivery. s5 captures actual response, resulting_status and unresolved_dependency at full time after delivery; instructions do not imply completed work. Save remains fully retained.
research_questions: Is there residual navigation among production task and schedule views?

incremental.description: Maintain native crew view and status labels

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final instructions and recipients

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only navigation changes: 15 times 30% = 4.5 hours less 1 upkeep = 3.5. Low halves navigation benefit: 2.25 minus 1 = 1.25.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with production colleagues about technical and creative details.

steps.what: Gather current script, photography, music, set and costume references using native project links
inputs: existing current production references and versions

steps.what: Confer with technical directors, managers, crew and writers about actual production details
outputs: actual discussion and agreed production details

steps.what: Write and approve the actual decisions, unresolved issues and responsible production owners
inputs: actual discussion and agreed production details

steps.what: Save the approved final production discussion note

tasks.design: Configure current-reference links in {PROJECT} to reduce finding the documents before discussion. Retain discussion and actual decision writing at full time. Final note approval precedes separate save; the existing same-system save earns no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current versions of multiple creative references may take repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project links can bring existing source versions together.
tasks.still_hard: Negotiating compatible technical and artistic choices.
tasks.human_edge: The director develops a shared interpretation with the people who will deliver it.
tasks.altitude: Production discussion with easier access to current references.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native project reference links can reduce retrieval of existing current production documents.

assumptions: All shares are provisional; credit only residual retrieval after current project links.

Existing writer, designer, music and technical owners supply their normal versioned references; no new uncounted documentation is assumed. s1 checks source and version. Missing references require manual gathering.
s3 captures actual decision, source_version, owner and unresolved_issue at full time after discussion. No note send is proposed. The separated save stays fully retained.
research_questions: Which current production references are repeatedly found manually before these discussions?

approvals.approved_version: s3 actual final production discussion note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only source retrieval changes: 15 times 30% = 4.5 hours minus 1 upkeep = 3.5. Low halves retrieval benefit: 2.25 minus 1 = 1.25.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Human production judgement and coordination with linked current sources.
reach: Less navigation while reviewing and coordinating production
skills_to_grow: Managing current production references and source versions
role.ambitious_version: The director finds current evidence quickly while retaining research, review, crew supervision and collaborative decisions.
